messages:
alex: FYI — Acme tenant reporting p99 spike on /v1/generate since ~2026-03-17T10:12Z. p95 looks fine but p99 jumping from ~1s to ~3s for short prompts. Suspect continuous-batcher config change last night.
incident-bot: Alert: tenant=acme-corp service=prod-rt-1 metric=p99 latency threshold crossed at 2026-03-17T10:15Z. Ticket #7892 created.
maria: quick peek at logs — bursts of tiny requests (<=32 tokens) followed by occasional large requests. continuous-batcher.grace_window_ms is 25 (was 8).
kevin: who rolled that change? was it from the adaptive coalesce experiment?
alex: config diff (last deploy):
```
- continuous-batcher.grace_window_ms: 8
+ continuous-batcher.grace_window_ms: 25
- coalesce.min_size: 2
+ coalesce.min_size: 1
```
this was in commit 6fa3b2f, deployed 03/17 02:30Z.
sam: I can repro locally. spinning a generator to send tiny prompts ~200 qps with a big 2k-token request every 500ms. will report numbers.
jen: short mitigation we can hotpatch: rollback grace_window to 8ms on canary and enable small-request fastpath: `batcher.enable_small_request_fastpath=true`
maria: note — token-introspect latency ticks up occasionally but traces indicate main delay is requests queued in batcher for extra hold time, not auth.
kevin: could kv-cache warmups be amplifying this? if small requests wait they might miss reuse windows.
maria: I looked at spans — requests sit in batch queue for ~18-40ms extra then sent as single-entry batch. kv-cache hit rates look unchanged during spikes.
alex: repro steps I used: short prompt curl at high rps + periodic large prompt to force batching collisions. example load generator:
```bash
# very small example using vegeta
echo "{\"prompt\": \"hi\"}" | vegeta attack -rate=200 -duration=60s | vegeta report
```
observed p99 jump matching production.
sam: applying hotfix to prod-canary now: `kubectl set env deploy/worker-batcher CONTINUOUS_BATCHER_GRACE_MS=8` and toggling `BATCHER_ENABLE_SMALL_FASTPATH=true` 
incident-bot: Deploy started on canary (worker-batcher) — 3 nodes.
jen: :thumbsup: monitoring acme tenant p99 and cluster-level tail metrics.
maria: after canary patch, acme p99 on canary nodes dropped from ~3.1s -> ~1.0s. looks promising.
kevin: longer-term we should add token-size based fastpath (bypass coalescing for <64 tokens) and add a metric for "batch-queue-wait-ms" per tenant.
alex: updated ticket #7892 with current status: hotfix applied to canary; full rollout pending 30m validation. cc @support-bot to notify customer.
support-bot: Support note appended to #7892: Temporary rollback of `continuous-batcher.grace_window_ms` to 8ms. Recommended follow-ups: implement fastpath for tiny prompts, add batch queue latency telemetry, add an automated canary check for tail regressions.
jen: Action items: 1) rollout rollback to prod (jen) 2) PR for fastpath + tests (sam) 3) add telemetry for tiny-prompt queue time (jen). I'll take 1 and 3.
sam: I'll own 2 and start a draft PR against eng-runtime with perf tests.
alex: thanks everyone — closing interim loop. we'll do a short postmortem if this recurs and tag the experiment that changed defaults.
